depicts: Composite of a rocky mountain with two waterfalls and a rainbow floating on a white cloud, with birds and a sun glow, on a pale pink-beige background.
composition: Mountain and cloud sit at centre; wide empty pastel space on all sides. Sun glow at top centre-left; cloud extends across the lower centre and fades into the background.
tone_and_contrast: Very light, low-contrast pastel background and cloud. Mountain is the darkest element with green and brown tones; rainbow and blue pool add small colour accents.
sharpness_and_artifacts: Video-frame compression softness. Mountain cut-out edge looks slightly rough at the sides. Cloud and background fade smoothly. No overlays or watermarks. Bottom centre shows a faint lighter vertical glow.
scan_first_read: A dreamy floating mountain island on a cloud with waterfall and rainbow; clear central subject.
